description: AuthentiCity: A Multi-Source Provenance-Aware Knowledge Graph and Benchmark for 3D City Models is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Huynh Duc An Son Nguyen, Lukas Arzoumanidis (HafenCity University Hamburg). AuthentiCity is a multi-source, provenance-aware 3D city knowledge graph spanning five cities on three continents. This record contains the five released graph instances as offline neo4j-admin database dump archives: Hamburg (DE), Helsinki (FI), Zurich (CH), New York (US) and Tokyo (JP). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
